nodes.speaker: corwin
nodes.text: The light failed at twenty to midnight. Thirty years I've kept it, and never once dark.

responses.text: Did you see anyone on the stair?

nodes.speaker: corwin
nodes.text: Aye — young Finn, coming down from the lamp room as the alarm bell rang. I'd stake my pension on it.

nodes.speaker: finn
nodes.text: Me? I never left the bunkroom all night. Never touched the stair, I swear it.

responses.text: Your coat smells of lamp oil.

nodes.speaker: finn
nodes.text: Oil? I... I trim the lamp some evenings. Ask Odda, not me — she's the one always climbing about.

nodes.speaker: odda
nodes.text: After supper I never left this galley, love. This bread's my witness — four hours a-rising, and me beside it.
